## Solution
# SageMath
p = 396430433566694153228963024068183195900644000015629930982017434859080008533624204265038366113052353086248115602503012179807206251960510130759852727353283868788493357310003786807

g_n_minus_1 = 88952575866827947965983024351948428571644045481852955585307229868427303211803239917835211249629755846575548754617810635567272526061976590304647326424871380247801316189016325247
g_n = 67077340815509559968966395605991498895734870241569147039932716484176494534953008553337442440573747593113271897771706973941604973691227887232994456813209749283078720189994152242

right_side = (g_n - 13 * g_n_minus_1) % p
b = (right_side * inverse_mod(24, p)) % p
a = (g_n_minus_1 - b) % p

F = GF(p)

base13 = F(13)
target_a = F(a)
n_minus_1 = discrete_log(target_a, base13)

secret = n_minus_1 + 1

print(f"Secret found: {secret}")

from Crypto.Util.number import long_to_bytes
flag = long_to_bytes(secret)
print(f"Flag: flag")
